source_analysis.contrast_policy: AA/AAA-first: body text 7:1 target, CTA text >= 4.5:1

contrast_report.wcag_note: Valores >= 4.5 son AA para texto normal; bg_text apunta a >= 7 cuando el palette lo permite.

design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #0D0D0B; --surface: #181510; --surface-alt: #282117; --text: #FFF7E8; --muted: #D9CDB7; --primary: #C77737; --accent: #66E0C2; --on-primary: #000000; --on-accent: #000000; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 6px; --gap: 16px; --blur: 14px; --nav-position: sticky; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .section-shell { width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 32px)); margin-inline: auto; } .cta-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font-weight: 800; box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .proof-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: var(--border); }  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
